title: Console sign-in by portal token, then a staff issuance
caption: console.auth.signIn (grantType portal_token) and console.bookings.issue as the OTA admin's server calls them (ota/docs/flows/console-operations.md §1, src/identity/staff, src/console/console-booking-actions.service.ts). No staff password exists on the OTA side.

steps.label: SET ptk:<sha256> {accountId, tenantId, membershipId, mfa} EX 60 NX
auto-submitting form to the OTA admin /sso
POST /v1/console/auth/sign-in {grantType: portal_token} (X-Api-Key = service key, end-user IP/agent)
GETDEL ptk:<sha256> (single use); staffdeny:acct:<accountId> cut-off
steps.note: Unknown/used/expired: 401 PORTAL_TOKEN_INVALID. Live tenant without MFA flag: 403 MFA_REQUIRED.

steps.label: membership + account + tenant active (past the 60 s cache); staff_actions staff.sign_in
staffsess:<familyId> (12 h family, rotating refresh hashes)
200 ConsoleStaffSession (EdDSA access JWT typ staff 15 min, refresh, permissions, environments)
POST /v1/console/bookings/{id}/issuance (Bearer staff token, X-Velexis-Environment, If-Match, Idempotency-Key)
PermissionGuard: bookings:issue for the role; live needs live tenant + non-viewer; else 403 + staff_actions denied
ticketing claim: ticketing_status in_progress (409 BOOKING_NOT_MODIFIABLE while a cancellation holds it)
capture the authorised payment (capturePayment default true; allowUnpaid owner/admin only)
Flight Order Management GET (resync), then Flight Order Issue
booking_tickets, booking ticketed, booking_events, staff_actions booking.issue (redacted before/after)
